title: AI clients (MCP)
lead: Claude, Cursor and other AI clients work in the Studio with its tools on your behalf over the Model Context Protocol.
serverOff: The MCP server is turned off on this installation. An administrator turns it on.

enable.label: Enable the MCP server
enable.hint: Clients connect at the address below. A disabled server answers 503.

files.title: Documents and files
files.hint: Read, search, edit, write, move and delete files.

build.title: Build
build.hint: Run a build, history, log, cancel.

history.title: History and git
history.hint: Versions, snapshots, rewind, git remote exchange.

admin.title: Administration
admin.hint: Users, queue, runners, audit. Only for an instance administrator with an MCP: administration token.

tools.lead: A client does not see a disabled tool. Dangerous ones (delete, rewind, git sync) are enabled by name.
tools.tokenHint: To connect, issue a token with the MCP permission: Settings → Account → Tokens.

connect.title: Connecting
connect.hintLocal: No token needed: the server only answers programs on this computer.
connect.hintServer: Put your token with the MCP permission in place of hsd_pat_...

clients.stdio: Claude Desktop and other clients that launch a process (stdio)

journal.title: Call log
journal.hint: Recent calls: tool, who, outcome and time. Arguments are not stored.

failure.unknown: The request failed. Try again later.
